description: A single-panel figure consisting of one rendered table (no image sub-panels, no axes, no scale bars). The table reports the chemical composition, in wt%, of three austenitic low-density steels (LDS) studied in the paper. Column headers, printed left to right after an unlabelled leftmost column, are Mn, Al, C, Ni and Fe. Rows are the three alloy grades, labelled 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni. Row 28Mn0Ni lists Mn 28.3, Al 9.0, C 0.9, Ni as a dash (not added) and Fe as "Balance". Row 28Mn5Ni lists Mn 28.1, Al 8.6, C 0.9, Ni 4.8 and Fe "Balance". Row 15Mn5Ni lists Mn 14.7, Al 9.8, C 0.9, Ni 4.1 and Fe "Balance". The table therefore documents the compositional design space: a constant 0.9 wt% C, near-constant ~9-10 wt% Al, and a deliberate variation in Mn (28 vs 15 wt%) and Ni (0 vs 4.8 vs 4.1 wt%) that produces the three distinct grades whose microstructures and deformation behaviour are compared elsewhere in the paper. No other values, units or annotations appear.

subfigures.description: A table of chemical composition in wt% with column headers Mn, Al, C, Ni, Fe and rows for the alloys 28Mn0Ni (28.3, 9.0, 0.9, -, Balance), 28Mn5Ni (28.1, 8.6, 0.9, 4.8, Balance) and 15Mn5Ni (14.7, 9.8, 0.9, 4.1, Balance).

observations.observation: The figure is a single table of chemical compositions in wt% for three LDS steel grades.
Column headers of the table are Mn, Al, C, Ni and Fe, with Fe reported as 'Balance'.
Row label 28Mn0Ni lists 28.3 Mn, 9.0 Al, 0.9 C, Ni shown as a dash, Fe balance.
Row label 28Mn5Ni lists 28.1 Mn, 8.6 Al, 0.9 C, 4.8 Ni, Fe balance.
Row label 15Mn5Ni lists 14.7 Mn, 9.8 Al, 0.9 C, 4.1 Ni, Fe balance.
All three alloys share the same C level of 0.9 wt% and similar Al levels of 8.6-9.8 wt%.
Mn content varies between the grades: ~28 wt% for 28Mn0Ni and 28Mn5Ni versus 14.7 wt% for 15Mn5Ni.
Ni is absent in 28Mn0Ni but present at 4.8 wt% (28Mn5Ni) and 4.1 wt% (15Mn5Ni).
The caption states the table gives the chemical composition (in wt%) of LDS steels used in this study.
